Note: LIVE in cellcounts_compiled.R since 2026-08-06. Kazu is Herculano-Houzel-team work, so the team rule in sec 8.2.H de-duplicates it automatically - priority by date then number of species, best source wins per species x variable, nothing special-cased. Kazu 2015 and HH 2015 tie on date, so the species-count tie-break hands the 80 SHARED pairs to HH and Kazu fills only gaps: 87 sub-structure values (hippocampus 20, pons+medulla 20, diencephalon+basal ganglia 16, mesencephalon 16, cortical grey 15) plus 21 whole-structure values HH lacks for these species.
